title: Efficient Models for the Detection of Hate, Abuse and Profanity

bias_targets.methodology: Training and evaluating a BERT-based binary classification model to assign probability scores representing the presence of hate speech, abusive language, and profanity in text segments, and using attention heatmaps to identify the most toxic tokens.

Qualitatively evaluating generative language model outputs (such as masked token completions and beam search generation) using prompts targeting specific demographic groups (e.g., 'Persian people', 'Arabs') to demonstrate the model's ability to filter and mitigate offensive associations.
